If your browser is filled with separate tabs for writing, image generation, document analysis, video editing, and AI chat, there’s a simpler approach. Through tomorrow, July 26, you can get the 1min.AI Advanced Business Plan Lifetime Subscription for a one-time $79.97, bringing a wide range of AI tools into one platform for life.

Instead of bouncing between different services, 1min.AI gives you access to leading AI models — including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and Cohere — alongside specialized tools for content creation, design, document management, audio production, and video editing.

Some of the features users are likely to appreciate most include:

  • 4,000,000 AI credits every month, plus opportunities to earn up to 450,000 additional monthly credits

  • AI writing tools for blog posts, rewrites, summaries, grammar, and brand voice

  • AI image generation, editing, background removal, and upscaling

  • PDF chat, document translation, presentation generation, and multi-document analysis

  • Text-to-video, image-to-video, YouTube summarization, and caption generation

  • Unlimited prompt library, unlimited storage, and unlimited brand voices

Because everything is organized within one interface, it’s easier to move between projects without constantly copying content between different AI platforms.

Whether you’re creating marketing content, researching, editing media, analyzing documents, or experimenting with AI for business, 1min.AI offers a practical way to consolidate your workflow into one subscription.
